new_processes.name: EOL deal change control
new_processes.definition: Enforcing and communicating the rules for handling EOL deals: they must stay at set points, must not be changed, and changes are reported to the responsible person.

new_processes.name: Counterparty existing-deal lookup
new_processes.definition: Querying the systems for existing deals with a list of counterparties and reporting the result to the requester.

new_processes.name: Deal counterparty correction
new_processes.definition: Checking and correcting the counterparty recorded on a deal when trade credit questions it.

new_processes.name: Transaction flow document review
new_processes.definition: Reviewing and editing a draft transaction flow process document, with sections assigned to reviewers and returned to the owner.

new_processes.name: Reorganization option planning
new_processes.definition: Collecting revisions to reorganization options ahead of a management meeting.
